subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-context opt-out, and if so should it be a Feishu-specific setting or a shared channel media-ingestion policy?
rationale: The reported key is not a shipped documented Feishu setting, and adding it changes channel config behavior plus the default attachment ingestion contract.

options.title: Add Backward-Compatible Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented Feishu top-level/per-account option that defaults to current media download behavior and switches file messages to placeholder-only context when disabled.

options.title: Use A Shared Channel Policy
options.body: Design a generic channel attachment-ingestion policy first, then wire Feishu into that shared contract so other channels can use the same semantics.

options.title: Document The Key As Unsupported
options.body: Leave current Feishu media ingestion unchanged and document that `mediaMaxMb` is the only supported Feishu media control today.

recommendation.title: Add Backward-Compatible Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented Feishu top-level/per-account option that defaults to current media download behavior and switches file messages to placeholder-only context when disabled.
